ORDINANCE LII OF 2002
FATIMA JINNAH
WOMEN UNIVERSITY, RAWALPINDI
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LII OF 2002
An Ordinance to amend the Fatima Jinnah Women
University Rawalpindi Ordinance, 1999
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 23rd September, 2002]
No. Legis.13-54/98/P-1, dated
23-9-2002.------The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information: -
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the. Fatima Jinnah Women
University Rawalpindi (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Addition of section 8-A in Ordinance XLIII of 1999

ORDINANCE LII OF 2002
FATIMA JINNAH
WOMEN UNIVERSITY, RAWALPINDI
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LII OF 2002
An Ordinance to amend the Fatima Jinnah Women
University Rawalpindi Ordinance, 1999
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 23rd September, 2002]
No. Legis.13-54/98/P-1, dated
23-9-2002.------The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information: -
2. Addition of section 8-A in
Ordinance XLIII of 1999.---In the said Ordinance, after section 9, the
following new section 8-A shall be added:--
"8-A. Revisional
powers of the Chancellor.--The Chancellor may, of his own. motion or
otherwise, call for and examine the record of any proceedings in which an order
has been passed by any authority for the purpose of satisfying himself as to
the correctness, legality or propriety of any finding or orders and may pass
such order as he may deem fit:
Provided that no order under this section shall be passed
unless the person to be affected thereby is afforded an opportunity of being
heard. "
